WITH orders AS (
    SELECT
        "Số CT" AS "order_id",
        DATE("Date") AS "order_date",
        "Date" AS "order_ts",
        "Mã thẻ" AS "customer_id",
        "Kênh đặt" AS "channel",
        "Phương thức TT" AS "payment",
        "Xử lý" AS "status"
    FROM "don_hang"
),
lines AS (
    SELECT
        o."order_id",
        o."order_date",
        o."order_ts",
        o."customer_id",
        o."channel",
        o."payment",
        o."status",
        l."Mã H.hóa" AS "product_code",
        l."SoLuong" AS "qty",
        l."dvt" AS "unit",
        l."Cộng" AS "amount",
        l."No." AS "line_no"
    FROM "chi_tiet_don" l
    JOIN orders o ON l."Mã bill" = o."order_id"
),
products AS (
    SELECT
        l."order_id",
        l."order_date",
        l."order_ts",
        l."customer_id",
        l."channel",
        l."payment",
        l."status",
        l."product_code",
        l."qty",
        l."unit",
        l."amount",
        l."line_no",
        COALESCE(p."Nhóm hàng", NULL) AS "product_group",
        COALESCE(p."ten_hang", l."product_code") AS "product_name"
    FROM lines l
    LEFT JOIN "san_pham" p ON l."product_code" = p."Mã vạch"
),
customers AS (
    SELECT
        p."order_id",
        p."order_date",
        p."order_ts",
        p."customer_id",
        p."channel",
        p."payment",
        p."status",
        p."product_code",
        p."qty",
        p."unit",
        p."amount",
        p."line_no",
        p."product_group",
        p."product_name",
        c."Khách lẻ/sỉ" AS "customer_name_raw"
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN "khach_hang" c ON p."customer_id" = c."Mã khách"
)
SELECT
    "order_id",
    "order_date",
    "order_ts",
    "product_code",
    "product_group",
    "product_name",
    "qty",
    "unit",
    "amount",
    "customer_id",
    CASE
        WHEN "customer_id" IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE("customer_name_raw", ''))) IN ('khách lẻ', 'kl', 'lẻ', 'vãng lai', '') THEN NULL
        ELSE "customer_name_raw"
    END AS "customer_name",
    "channel",
    "payment",
    NULL AS "staff",
    CASE WHEN "status" = 'cancelled' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS "is_cancelled",
    CASE WHEN "status" = 'returned' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS "is_returned",
    'item' AS "line_kind"
FROM customers
ORDER BY "order_id", "line_no"
